input.objective: Launch PLEA on Ethereum mainnet from this Foundry repository exactly as launch.json lists it: six contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, Laureates, PleaDistributor, PleaLaunch), deployed in order in one transaction with the constructor arguments in launch.json. This is the code of Sepolia launch #1242 plus three changes: the cap decays to its floor in 25 days, a POOL4-style wall placement guard, and Intake v2 (requestWithFailure; onPleaFailure only clears our own pending plea and never moves value). Audit the imported code and deploy it unchanged; fix only what the audit proves is a real bug, and keep every number as it is (fees, timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 15-day seasons, 33-hour dead-man, credit gas 1300000). PleaHook is not a launch.json entry: PleaLaunch.deployHook deploys it after launch with a salt mined off chain. Keep foundry.toml as it is, including [lint] lint_on_build = false.
